title: Re-Enforce
summary: RE-ENFORCE, verb transitive [re and enforce.] To strengthen with new force, assistance or support, as to re-enforce an argument; but particularly, to strengthen an army or a fort with additional troop

inlines.v: RE-ENFORCE, verb transitive [re and enforce.] To strengthen with new force, assistance or support, as to re-enforce an argument; but particularly, to strengthen an army or a fort with additional troops, or a navy with additional ships.
